candidate_rule: Scores and ranks never imply an accepted mapping or a review confidence.
relation_direction: MASCO source occupation to ESCO target occupation
cardinality: A MASCO occupation has zero, one, or many accepted ESCO counterparts; an ESCO occupation may receive many MASCO occupations.
acceptance_policy: Two distinct independent human reviewers with evidence, a separate human adjudicator, explicit completed adjudication and acceptable relation. No automatic migration of pilot proxy labels.
versioning: Never overwrite source imports, completed reviewer decisions or released accepted mappings. Superseding decisions must reference prior IDs in rationale and be resolved into a new release input.
skills: Not part of crosswalk acceptance. Later skill transfer is separately evaluated and preserves official essential/optional labels; 100/50 are pilot project weights only.
